subject.title: fix(agent): stale replies after queued user turns

question: Should OpenClaw land this preserve-as-context metadata-walk repair as the canonical fix for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/76888, or prefer the stale-internal-drop semantics from https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/96533?
rationale: Both open PRs target the same stale-reply root cause but encode different provider-visible session-state semantics, and automation should not choose that product contract by itself.

options.title: Accept preserve-as-context
options.body: Land this PR after refresh and exact-head validation if maintainers want older queued user text retained as context-only while the latest active prompt remains the answer target.

options.title: Prefer stale-internal-drop
options.body: Keep https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/96533 as the canonical path if maintainers want selected internal orphan prompts removed instead of preserved in provider-visible context.

options.title: Request a combined repair
options.body: Ask for one narrow update that combines this PR's metadata walk with provenance-aware drop/preserve semantics before either PR lands.

recommendation.title: Accept preserve-as-context
recommendation.body: Land this PR after refresh and exact-head validation if maintainers want older queued user text retained as context-only while the latest active prompt remains the answer target.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is closest to the queued-user prompt preservation and embedded-runner orphan-repair invariant shown in current-main blame and PR history.
